name: axiomre
description: Open-source reverse engineering workbench for evidence-first human and AI-assisted analysis.

scripts.smoke:rea: npm run build:core && npm run build:provider && node scripts/smoke-rea-provider.mjs fixtures/pe/minimal-x64.exe
scripts.dev: npm run install:electron && npm run build:core && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:provider && npm run dev -w @axiomre/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:provider && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:provider && npm run typecheck -w @axiomre/core && npm run typecheck -w @axiomre/plugin-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @axiomre/provider-rea && npm run typecheck -w @axiomre/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @axiomre/core && npm run test -w @axiomre/provider-rea
scripts.check: npm run fixtures:generate && npm run licenses:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
